description: GET /v1/merchants/me/sessions/:id/webhook - delivery state of the session's latest webhook event: the event (null before the first one), resendableEndpointCount (enabled endpoints subscribed to its type - the ones sessions_retry_webhook reaches) and, per endpoint, delivered, resendInProgress, exhausted and the next automatic attempt. Uses the cached sk_* key of the selected mode, else a fresh JWT. Read-only.
name: sessions_webhook_status
title: Read webhook delivery status of a session
